units.source_text: 上下两卷各有约莫六十页，里面所记载的“黄金传说”，上卷八篇，下卷十篇。

en.t: The upper and lower volumes each have about sixty pages, and the Golden Legend recorded inside consists of eight pieces in the first volume and ten in the second.

units.source_text: 上下两卷的卷首各有序言，没有作者署名，分别有拉丁文目次。

en.t: At the beginning of both the upper and lower volumes there is a preface, with no author signature, and each has its own table of contents in Latin.

units.source_text: 序言文不甚驯，中间夹杂一些如欧文直译过来的语法，一眼就能看出来必定是出自西方传教士的手笔。

en.t: The prefaces are not very polished, and they contain some grammatical turns that seem to have been translated directly from European languages, so one can tell at a glance that they must have been written by Western missionaries.
